name: Mishtann Foods Limited
about: Mishtann Foods Limited engages in the manufacturing, processing, and trading of basmati and raw rice, rice, wheat, dal, salt, and other food grains in India. The company was formerly known as HICS Cements Ltd. and changed its name to Mishtann Foods Limited in February 2015. Mishtann Foods Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
